name: com.likeminds.customgallery.media.view.MediaPickerActivity
description: LikeMinds Custom Gallery (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when the app requests photo, video, document or audio attachments. It lets the user browse local media or Android's document picker, then returns the selection to the app.
disableEffect: The app loses this media picker, so screens that attach files through it cannot complete.
